title: México y el TLCAN
goal: Read about the shocks of the mid-1990s in Mexico -- the assassination of Luis Donaldo Colosio, the abrupt peso devaluation, and the rescue it prompted -- following NAFTA's entry into force.
grammar: A raíz de que: como consecuencia directa de que (algo ocurriera)

items: State what NAFTA was expected to do for trade among its members.
Explain what happened to Luis Donaldo Colosio.
Describe why the Mexican government devalued the peso.
Explain what the United States organized when the devaluation threatened other emerging economies.
Use a raíz de que to name the direct trigger of an event.
